extraction.Name: Will Justice
extraction.Buyer: Pawnee Nat. Bank, Pawnee County, Okla.
extraction.Occupation/Income: Has an income of about $400 per year, inherited land. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Date and manner of delivery of patent Dec. 4, 1917, Agency office; receipted for yes; mortgage released; land has not been sold; no property or money accumulated; good health; questions and answers to circular No. 2464, June 18, 1928
